sentences.sentence: Localised disease may be treated at first with relatively inexpensive drugs such as nystatin, miconazole or clotrimazole.
sentences.translation: 治疗局部感染可先使用较为便宜的药物，如制霉菌素、咪康唑或克霉唑等。

sentences.sentence: The results of drug sensitivity showed that amphotericin (AMB) and nystatin (NYS) were the most sensitive and flucytosine (5- Fc ) was the most resistant (54.2%).
sentences.translation: 药敏结果显示，药物敏感性最高为两性霉素（AMB）和制霉菌素（NYS），耐药性最高的为5-氟胞嘧啶（54.2%）。

sentences.sentence: The document was compiled by the Department of Health.

sentences.sentence: the artist’s prodigious output
sentences.translation: 那位艺术家惊人的高产

sentences.sentence: This work is clearly connected with The Last Supper: the Christ has the same ethereal and elusive quality as the faded figure at the centre of Leonardo's sublime mural.
sentences.translation: 这幅画显然和《最后的晚餐》有某种关联：画中的基督，和达·芬奇最伟大的壁画中心那已褪色的基督形象一样，同样空灵缥缈。

sentences.sentence: In fact, he once took a hiatus from acting to study shoemaking.
sentences.translation: 事实上，他曾经一度中断演艺生涯跑去学习制鞋。

sentences.sentence: Iran's main shoemaking federation also offered to supply a lifetime of shoes to Zaidi, who remains in a Baghdad jail awaiting trial.
sentences.translation: 伊朗制鞋协会还向扎一迪奉送了“终身鞋”，然而扎一迪却在巴格达一所监狱等待着审判。

sentences.sentence: The Frenchman began his shoemaking career at Les Compagnons du Tour de France, a venerable crafts guild.
sentences.translation: 这名法国人的制鞋生涯从知名的手工业协会──法国传统艺师培训所(Les Compagnons du Tour de France)开始。

sentences.sentence: a generous glass of wine

sentences.sentence: He sprawled out on the sofa.
sentences.translation: 他摊开手脚躺在沙发上。

sentences.sentence: I tripped on a stone and went sprawling on the pavement.
sentences.translation: 我被一块石头绊了一下，四仰八叉地摔在人行道上。

sentences.sentence: a blow which sent him sprawling
sentences.translation: 打得他四脚朝天的一拳

sentences.sentence: rose petals
sentences.translation: 玫瑰花瓣

sentences.sentence: The flower has seven petals.
sentences.translation: 这种花有七片花瓣。

sentences.sentence: However, if the inhabitants are technologically inferior, you should find a small tribe of primitives as soon as possible.
sentences.translation: 然而，如果这些居民的科技次于地球，你应该尽快找到一个小的原始部落。

sentences.sentence: It s also the first germanium laser to operate at room temperature.
sentences.translation: 这同样也是第一速在室温下得到控制的锗激光。

sentences.sentence: The researchers inject pairs of electrons and holes into the germanium.
sentences.translation: 研究者们注射成对的电子和凹陷到锗中。

sentences.sentence: Changing the angle and length of the bonds between germanium atoms also changed the energies required to kick their electrons into the conduction band.
sentences.translation: 改变锗原子的连接角度和长度的同时，将它们的电子踢到传导带所需的能量也变化了。

sentences.translation: 我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

sentences.translation: 她打开门，跨过门槛。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 216 单元

stake
音标：英 /steɪk/  美 /stek/
n. 树桩
短语：at stake — 危如累卵；处于危险中；在紧要关头
短语：stake someone to something — 为某人取得某物而提供金钱(或援助)，资助某人取得某物
短语：equity stake — 股权
短语：go to the stake — ◎(被绑在火刑柱上)受火刑
短语：have a stake in — 与…利害攸关
短语：stake out — 监视；立桩标出；派警察监视
短语：stake on — 在...上打赌；把赌注押在...上面
例句：tent stakes
帐篷桩

disloyalty
音标：英 /dɪs'lɒɪ(ə)ltɪ/  美 /dis'lɔiəlti/
n. 不忠实
例句：Charges had already been made against certain officials suspected of disloyalty.
已对某些被怀疑有不忠行为的官员提出指控。

certainty
音标：英 /'sɜːt(ə)ntɪ; -tɪn-/  美 /'sɝtnti/
n. 确定, 确实的事情
短语：with certainty — 确定无疑地
短语：to a certainty — 必定，肯定
短语：for a certainty — 确实，确定无疑地
短语：certainty factor — 可信度；确定性因素
例句：The result is impossible to predict with any degree of certainty .
这一结果完全无法确切预测。

nystatin
n. [微]制霉菌素
例句：Localised disease may be treated at first with relatively inexpensive drugs such as nystatin, miconazole or clotrimazole.
治疗局部感染可先使用较为便宜的药物，如制霉菌素、咪康唑或克霉唑等。
例句：The results of drug sensitivity showed that amphotericin (AMB) and nystatin (NYS) were the most sensitive and flucytosine (5- Fc ) was the most resistant (54.2%).
药敏结果显示，药物敏感性最高为两性霉素（AMB）和制霉菌素（NYS），耐药性最高的为5-氟胞嘧啶（54.2%）。

compile
音标：英 /kəm'paɪl/  美 /kəm'paɪl/
v. 编译, 编辑
短语：compile time — 编译时间
例句：The document was compiled by the Department of Health.
这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

prodigious
音标：英 /prə'dɪdʒəs/  美 /prə'dɪdʒəs/
adj. 巨大的, 惊人的
例句：the artist’s prodigious output
那位艺术家惊人的高产

mural
音标：英 /'mjʊər(ə)l/  美 /'mjʊrəl/
adj. 墙壁的  n壁画
短语：mural painting — 壁画
例句：This work is clearly connected with The Last Supper: the Christ has the same ethereal and elusive quality as the faded figure at the centre of Leonardo's sublime mural.
这幅画显然和《最后的晚餐》有某种关联：画中的基督，和达·芬奇最伟大的壁画中心那已褪色的基督形象一样，同样空灵缥缈。

fountain
音标：英 /ˈfaʊntən/  美 /'faʊntn/
n. 喷泉
短语：fountain pen — n. 钢笔
短语：water fountain — 饮水器；供应饮用水之处
短语：fountain of youth — 青春之泉
短语：soda fountain — 冷饮柜台，冷饮小卖部
短语：drinking fountain — n. （设于公共场所的）自动饮水器
例句：...the fountains on the 16th Street Mall.
…第16街商业区的喷泉。

gatherer
音标：美 /'ɡæðərɚ/
n. 收集者, 收集器
例句：information gatherers
信息收集者

shoemaking
n. 制鞋
例句：In fact, he once took a hiatus from acting to study shoemaking.
事实上，他曾经一度中断演艺生涯跑去学习制鞋。
例句：Iran's main shoemaking federation also offered to supply a lifetime of shoes to Zaidi, who remains in a Baghdad jail awaiting trial.
伊朗制鞋协会还向扎一迪奉送了“终身鞋”，然而扎一迪却在巴格达一所监狱等待着审判。
例句：The Frenchman began his shoemaking career at Les Compagnons du Tour de France, a venerable crafts guild.
这名法国人的制鞋生涯从知名的手工业协会──法国传统艺师培训所(Les Compagnons du Tour de France)开始。

electrically
音标：英 /ɪ'lektrɪkəlɪ/
adv. 用电力;有关电地
短语：electrically operated — 电动操作的
短语：electrically connected — 电气性连接
短语：electrically operated valve — 电动阀

generous
音标：英 /'dʒen(ə)rəs/  美 /'dʒɛnərəs/
adj. 慷慨的,丰富的
短语：be generous with — 用…很大方
短语：be generous in — 乐于……
例句：a generous glass of wine
一大杯葡萄酒

sprawl
音标：英 /sprɔːl/  美 /sprɔl/
v. 伸开
短语：urban sprawl — 城市扩张；都市向郊区扩张的现象
例句：He sprawled out on the sofa.
他摊开手脚躺在沙发上。
例句：I tripped on a stone and went sprawling on the pavement.
我被一块石头绊了一下，四仰八叉地摔在人行道上。
例句：a blow which sent him sprawling
打得他四脚朝天的一拳

petal
音标：英 /'pet(ə)l/  美 /'pɛtl/
n. 花瓣
例句：rose petals
玫瑰花瓣
例句：The flower has seven petals.
这种花有七片花瓣。

technologically
adv. 科技地
例句：However, if the inhabitants are technologically inferior, you should find a small tribe of primitives as soon as possible.
然而，如果这些居民的科技次于地球，你应该尽快找到一个小的原始部落。

proportionately
adv. 相称地, 成比例地

germanium
音标：英 /dʒɜː'meɪnɪəm/  美 /dʒɝ'menɪəm/
n. 锗
例句：It s also the first germanium laser to operate at room temperature.
这同样也是第一速在室温下得到控制的锗激光。
例句：The researchers inject pairs of electrons and holes into the germanium.
研究者们注射成对的电子和凹陷到锗中。
例句：Changing the angle and length of the bonds between germanium atoms also changed the energies required to kick their electrons into the conduction band.
改变锗原子的连接角度和长度的同时，将它们的电子踢到传导带所需的能量也变化了。

likelihood
音标：英 /'laɪklɪhʊd/  美 /'laɪklɪhʊd/
n. 可能(性)
短语：maximum likelihood — 极大似然；最大似然率
短语：likelihood ratio — 概率比；似然率
短语：likelihood estimation — 似然估算
短语：maximum likelihood estimation — 最大似然估计；最大相似估计法
短语：in all likelihood — adv. 十分可能
短语：likelihood function — 似然函数
短语：maximum likelihood estimator — 最大似然估计值；极大似然估计量；最大概似推定量
例句：If I refused, it would in all likelihood mean I’d lose my job.
如果我拒绝，那我十有八九会丢掉工作。

charter
音标：英 /'tʃɑːtə/  美 /'tʃɑrtɚ/
v. 租 n宪章
短语：charter party — 佣船契约；包船契约；租船方
短语：olympic charter — 奥林匹克宪章
短语：charter flight — 包机
短语：time charter — 定期租船契约
短语：corporate charter — 公司执照；公司注册证
短语：bareboat charter — 空船租赁
短语：charter school — 特许学校，契约学校；委办学校
短语：voyage charter — 程租船；计程包船；航程佣船
短语：royal charter — 皇家宪章（英国法律）
短语：atlantic charter — n. 大西洋宪章
短语：great charter — 大宪章（等于Magna Charta）
例句：We chartered a boat to take us to some of the smaller islands.
我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

threshold
音标：英 /'θreʃəʊld; 'θreʃ,həʊld/  美 /'θrɛʃhold/
n. 门槛, 开端
短语：threshold value — [计]阈值；门限值；界限值
短语：damage threshold — 损伤阈值，损坏阈
短语：pain threshold — [生理]痛阈
短语：threshold voltage — 阈值电压；[物]阈电压
短语：on the threshold of — 在...的开端
短语：threshold current — [电]阈值电流
短语：lower threshold — n. 下辨别阈
短语：detection threshold — 探测限界，检测阈
短语：threshold level — 阈电平
短语：threshold effect — 门槛效应；识阈效应
短语：visual threshold — 视觉阈
短语：tax threshold — 所得税起征点
短语：hearing threshold — 听阈
短语：alarm threshold — 报警阈值；警戒点
短语：threshold energy — 能限；阈能
短语：excitation threshold — 兴奋阈；激励阈值
短语：threshold dose — [放射]阈剂量
例句：She opened the door and stepped across the threshold.
她打开门，跨过门槛。
